svg.title: Incoming transmission from aipulsedaily
svg.desc: $ whoami aipulsedaily (@aipulseda1ly on X). tracking every AI model drop, benchmark leak and lab move. $ cat method.txt I test new models myself, usually the day they drop. full runs, nothing cut. every number gets checked against the source. $ cat rules.txt no partnerships. no sponsored reviews. a lab gets featured fairly or not at all. $ aipulse --live ▸ 1,287 followers · 1,637 posts on X since Feb 10, 2026 ▸ 389K views and counting on the Claude Opus 5 F1 film ▸ 4 new models on OpenRouter in the last 7 days. newest: Claude Haiku 5.5 $ echo $MOTTO signal over noise.
